reason: No city-by-upper-secondary teaching FTE or matching pupil count is contained in these three sources; these establish a custom-request route and collection variables, not a downloadable result.

request_page.html.evidence: Offers tailored statistical information on learners, school staff and completions; requests via bista@bi.zh.ch.

survey_coverage.html.evidence: SSP is a census of school staff activities at schools located in the canton, including Sekundarstufe II; data suppliers include public and private schools, school municipalities and offices; annual reference date 15 September except tertiary on 1 November.

page_1.levels: Individual school personnel and their school activities; annual census.
page_1.field_definition_note: The source lists field names, not detailed coding, the workload-to-FTE formula, allocation rules or completeness by city and stage.

requested_aggregate.school_year: Same specified most recent available school year for both measures; report reference dates and publication/revision date
requested_aggregate.geography: Schools physically located in Stadt Zürich; request treatment of multi-site or cross-municipality administrative records and counts or FTE unallocated
requested_aggregate.stage: Sekundarstufe II, explicitly identify included programmes and allocate mixed lower/upper-secondary institutions to upper-secondary teaching and pupils
requested_aggregate.providers: Provide all providers together and public/private disaggregation if available; report exclusions and missing coverage
requested_aggregate.disclosure: Request aggregate values and methodological notes, no personal data; provide uncertainty, withheld cells, linkability and known mismatches.
requested_aggregate.teacher_denominator: Sum actual teaching activity FTE with workload and full-time base, exclude school leadership and non-teaching duties; explain imputation, allocation and suppression
requested_aggregate.pupil_numerator: Number of pupils in same school year, school locations, programmes, provider coverage and study modes as teacher FTE; state snapshot, age, residency and part-time treatment

caveats: A census of public and private suppliers does not establish that each requested city-stage cell is complete or disclosable.
School identification and workload fields do not establish that all activities can be assigned precisely by location and stage.
School-location pupil counts include pupils who live outside the city and exclude city residents enrolled elsewhere.
No number, ratio, model input, or claim of a received data response is supported by this package.
